scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -n app,typescript "npm run watch:app" "tsc -w"
scripts.copy:fontawesome: shx cp node_modules/font-awesome/css/font-awesome.min.css public/css && shx cp node_modules/font-awesome/fonts/* public/fonts
scripts.copy:select2: shx cp node_modules/select2/dist/js/select2.min.js public/js/vendor && shx cp node_modules/select2/dist/css/select2.min.css public/css
scripts.copy:bootstrap: shx cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.min.js public/js/vendor && shx cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css public/css
scripts.copy:vendor: npm run copy:bootstrap && npm run copy:jquery && npm run copy:fontawesome && npm run copy:jsonstat-toolkit && npm run copy:ajv && npm run copy:select2 && shx cp -r src/js/vendor public/js
scripts.copy:app: shx cp -r src/config src/css src/fonts src/imgs src/schemas src/*.html src/favicon.ico src/i18n public
scripts.prebuild: rimraf public && mkdirp public/js/vendor && mkdirp public/fonts && mkdirp public/css
scripts.build: concurrently -n copy:vendor,copy:app,typescript "npm run copy:vendor" "npm run copy:app" "tsc"
